label: caiso 19 outage regate
definition: 3-YEAR re-gate of the caiso-15 all-flags keeper (commitment, priced-interchange, 2024 hydro repin + EIA-930 monthly, gas-hub-basis overlay, import gas-coupling + solar-shape) on the net-load-filtered CAMPD unit-outages (commit b0c41cb). Byte-faithful; only the outage input changed. 2024 reproduces caiso-18 (the 2024-only re-gate) EXACTLY (mean 41.17, neg 408 @ 91.9% precision), confirming 3-yr consistency. LMP gating (vs actual DA; 2023 has no actual LMP yet -> fuel-mix-gated only): 2024 mean 41.17 vs actual 35.85 (resid +5.32), neg 408 @ 91.9%/recall 49.7%; 2025 mean 49.31 vs actual 34.62 (resid +14.69), p95 79.81 vs 58.87 (+20.94), neg 16 vs 561 (prec 37.5%, recall 1.1%) -- 2025 runs structurally HOT and misses the negative tail (a known open issue, not introduced here). Model system price avg: 2023 62.17, 2024 41.17, 2025 49.31. Gas TWh vs EIA-923: 2023 66.15/76.04 (-13%), 2024 71.85/67.68 (+6%), 2025 71.32/55.18 (+29%). The CC-over/peaker-under mix defect (TASK-2, a commitment/merit-order property) persists across all 3 years. Companion to the 2024-only caiso-18; see DIAGNOSIS-caiso-fleet-mix-outage-2026-06-21.
